question: Which of the following statements about the 2023 Intercontinental Cup final is correct?

options.text: The final was held in Guwahati where India defeated Lebanon.
The final was held in Bhubaneswar where India defeated Lebanon.
The final was held in Imphal where India defeated Lebanon.
The final was held in Ahmedabad where India defeated Lebanon.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The final was held in Bhubaneswar where India defeated Lebanon.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 2023 Intercontinental Cup final was held in **Bhubaneswar**, Odisha.
 
• India defeated Lebanon 2-0 in the final, securing their third Intercontinental Cup title.
 
• The match was held at the **Kalinga Stadium**, which has become a prominent venue for hosting international sports events.
 
• **Sunil Chhetri**, India’s captain, played a crucial role throughout the tournament, demonstrating outstanding leadership and performance.
 
• This victory marked a significant achievement for the Indian football team under the guidance of coach **Igor Stimac**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Main Theme: 2023 Intercontinental Cup**

 
 
• The Intercontinental Cup is a football tournament organized by the All India Football Federation (AIFF).
 
• The competition serves as preparation for India’s senior men’s national team ahead of major international tournaments.
 
• Teams from Asia, Africa, and other regions participate in the tournament.
 
• The 2023 edition saw India, Lebanon, Vanuatu, and Mongolia competing in the tournament.
